verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's official integrations page says you can build search interfaces by pairing Meilisearch with React InstantSearch, a third-party component library rather than one Meilisearch ships itself. The engine provides faceting data meant to power UI navigation, but the evidence never shows ready-made Meilisearch widgets. Missing for 10: a first-party Meilisearch UI component library, documentation of specific search box/results/facet/pagination widgets, coverage of frameworks beyond React, and hands-on corroboration of assembling a full UI this way.
